visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide eye-level shot of a modern architectural structure with a silver-grey, tiered facade. In the foreground, a large metallic 'TECH WORLD' sign is visible. A male character in a green utility vest stands near the sign, smiling and gesturing toward the building. Dozens of people are seen in a queue behind a rope barrier. (2) The scene shifts to the interior, showing a massive cylindrical digital screen displaying a lush forest animation with brown bears and deer. Floating white fabric strips hang from the ceiling. A close-up shot shows a hand interacting with a purple-lit pixelated wall that reacts to touch. (3) The camera moves through a wooden beam structure with high ceilings and pillars. A staff member in a white branded uniform hands a green smartwatch tracker to the narrator. Subsequent shots show a room filled with real white orchids and floating light-projection butterflies, followed by a dark hallway with glowing dots on the floor. (4) Inside a retail section, digital menu boards show bubble tea and snacks. Shelves are filled with colorful packaged food products like 'Gummy' and 'Pineapple Cakes'. A large glass display case filled with hundreds of red, round mascots with big eyes is shown. (5) The final shot returns to the exterior of the pavilion where the main character smiles at the camera while the large 'TECH WORLD' sign is framed prominently in the foreground. The lighting is bright and natural throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你來大阪萬博一定要來TECH WORLD館. (2) [Subtitle]: 我現在就在 2025 大阪萬博 帶你搶先感受這場關於 科技、自然與未來的 沉浸式體驗!. (3) [Subtitle]: 這座展館的設計靈感 來自臺灣的山巒 銀白色的外牆會隨著光影變化 就像科技與自然交織的 未來畫面. (4) [Subtitle]: 找到大根屋 30號柱 就可以找到展館. (5) [Subtitle]: 第一站是 生命劇場 你會看到 560 台機器人 與影像共舞 模擬臺灣生態的生命力. (6) [Subtitle]: 這不只是科技 更是一場充滿情感的演出!. (7) [Subtitle]: 接著，我們來到 自然劇場 360 度環繞投影 讓你瞬間走進臺灣的 山林、平原、大海 甚至還能聞到森林的氣息 感受到水流的震動!. (8) [Subtitle]: 最後的 未來劇場 帶你看見智慧城市 AI 科技 甚至是人類探索宇宙的可能性 這些不只是想像 而是臺灣正在實現的未來. (9) [Subtitle]: 最特別的是 每位來訪者都會配戴一條 AI 互動手環 它能感測你的反應 並為你量身推薦一趟 專屬的臺灣旅程 讓這場展覽成為你的全新啟程. (10) [Subtitle]: 這不只是一座展館 而是一場與世界的對話 現在，就跟我一起探索 TECH WORLD 館 看見科技與自然共存的未來!. (11) [Subtitle]: 2025 大阪萬博 TECH WORLD 館在這裡 等你來體驗! 只要留言 我就抽選一名 送你現場拿到的禮物喔.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male narrator in a green vest, approximately 4-5 staff members in white uniforms, and a large crowd of over 20 visitors in queues and exhibition halls.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged East Asian man wearing a green utility vest with multiple pockets over a dark shirt, carrying a backpack and a camera strap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The pavilion features modern silver stepped exterior walls, interior spaces with high-tech curved LED screens, large wooden beam architectural structures, and a retail zone with clean white shelving and digital menus.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a punchy electronic pop track featuring a driving 4/4 drum beat and bright synthesizers. A male narrator speaks enthusiastically in Mandarin, with high clarity and a friendly, upbeat inflection. Faint background murmur of a crowd is audible beneath the voice. (2) A sharp synthesised 'whoosh' sound effects a transition. The music continues, maintaining a consistent high energy. The narrator's speech rate is fast and professional. During nature visuals, subtle bird chirps and wind sound effects are layered into the mix. (3) Digital 'ping' and 'beep' UI sounds occur as the narrator interacts with the screens and receives the wearable device. The narrator's tone shifts to a slightly more awe-struck, melodic delivery when describing the 'Future Theater'. (4) The music transitions into a slightly more melodic, celebratory theme during the retail and gift giveaway segment. The narrator's vocal arousal increases, concluding with a warm, energetic sign-off over the fading musical outro.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Introduction -> Pavilion Highlight Features -> Interactive Tech Demo -> Souvenirs/Retail -> CTA/Giveaway
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and showcase the 'TECH WORLD' pavilion at the 2025 Osaka World Expo, highlighting its Taiwanese cultural roots, immersive digital experiences, and interactive technology to encourage tourism and engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal call to visit the pavilion, showcasing specific branded merchandise and giveaways.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-tempo editing and vibrant multimodal interactions to convey a sense of futuristic wonder balanced with cultural heritage.
